background.working_life: At 52, he works part-time as an employee, putting in fifteen hours or fewer each week as a manager in logistics, warehousing and transport within the wholesale and retail trade sector. The role carries supervisory responsibility for a team, placing him in lower managerial and administrative work. Holding a degree-level or higher qualification, he brings formal training to scheduling, stock movement and staff oversight. His workplace lies less than two kilometres away, and he drives a car or van there rather than working from home.
background.home_and_household: He lives in a detached house or bungalow in a village or rural part of the East of England, owned with a mortgage or loan. The household contains four people: himself, his wife, and two dependent children, the youngest aged between twelve and fifteen, with three or more adults counted in total. He is recorded as the husband of the household reference person. The property has two or more bedrooms beyond what the household requires, giving generous space for everyone under one roof.
background.week_and_hobbies: With short working hours and a very brief commute, his week leaves considerable time outside employment, much of it shaped by two teenage children and their school and activity timetables. Rural life in the East of England lends itself to gardening, walking country lanes, and general upkeep of a detached property and its grounds. The car is useful for longer trips to nearby towns for errands or family outings. Weekends often revolve around household projects, driving family members about, and quieter time at home.
